LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Suin.label: Suin
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Suin.description: Suin is a princess of the Ratkin kingdom who follows the lives of those caught in the famine. She records the Ratkin, hunger and plague your colony encounters, and writes about how events turn out. She will not make your decisions for you.\n\nHer pacing resembles Randy Random, with Ratkin crises adding further challenges. With stories enabled, her trust affects the spacing of raids and other major threats: more trust means more breathing room, less trust means more frequent danger. The strength of individual raids still follows your difficulty settings and random variation.
